# With --opt maps=true, html's JS bundle carries an inline SNGL->bundled
# source map. The JS translator emits /*@SNGL:file:line@*/ markers at
# statement boundaries; the html bundler extracts them, builds a SNGL->JS
# map, and feeds it to esbuild via a data-URL sourceMappingURL so esbuild
# chains through to a SNGL->bundled output map.

sngl generate --lang=none --platform=html --opt=maps=true --out=out app.sngl
exists out/index.html

# Esbuild emits an inline source map for the IIFE.
grep 'sourceMappingURL=data:application/json' out/index.html

# Sanity: without maps the inline source map is absent.
sngl generate --lang=none --platform=html --out=out2 app.sngl
exists out2/index.html
! grep 'sourceMappingURL=data:application/json' out2/index.html

-- app.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"

component main node {
    var count = 0
    text(value=string(count))
    button(text="+", @click { count += 1 })
}

window {
    main
}
